name: 1GLOBAL
description: Provision 1GLOBAL Connect subscriptions and SIM profiles, manage customer accounts, browse plans, top up subscriptions, and track orders. Uses production client credentials and API version 2026-02-05.

credential_fields.name: client_id

credential_fields.description: Production client secret supplied by 1GLOBAL. Apteva obtains and renews access tokens automatically.
